parameters.tie_break: the smallest applicable payload; a tie goes to the lowest codec id, exactly as the production selector does

definitions.file_bytes: the size a whole file would occupy: the payload of every tile, plus the container framing (a 64-byte header, a 40-byte directory entry per tile, and one 4-byte CRC trailer over the directory)
definitions.stable_auto: the per-tile selection over the v0.1 and v0.2 codec ids only (raw, palette, rle, predictor) — what the encoder writes today
definitions.extended_auto: the per-tile selection over the v0.3 codec ids: the four original codecs plus the three promoted in this milestone (lz77, predictor+dictionary, context-entropy) — what the encoder writes once the promotion lands
definitions.ratio: file bytes divided by canonical pixel bytes; below 1.0 is smaller
definitions.exact: the harness decoded every tile and compared it with the source bytes
